def most_frequent_characters(s):
    frequency = {}
    for char in s:
        if char in frequency:
            frequency[char] += 1
        else:
            frequency[char] = 1
    max_count = max(frequency.values())
    most_frequent = [char for char, count in frequency.items() if count == max_count]
    return most_frequent, max_count
